exact: cytoplasmic face of Golgi trans cisterna membrane
cytoplasmic leaflet of Golgi trans cisterna membrane
cytoplasmic side of Golgi trans cisternae membrane

definition: The membrane leaflet of the trans-Golgi cisternae that faces the cytoplasm. It is the site of protein and lipid interaction, vesicle formation, and cargo sorting towards post-Golgi destinations such as endosomes, lysosomes, and the plasma membrane.
label: cytoplasmic side of trans-Golgi cisterna membrane
